evidence: The portable rights model names eight independent actions and binds every decision to one retained source assertion, exact copy/location/resource, purpose and destination. Unknown or source-reported license/access terms never grant use; 48 fresh rights tests exercise missing, conflicting, expired, actor-specific, wrong-copy and connector-sibling boundaries. The only no-policy allow is a protected, exact confirmed import-member local-metadata bridge for four corpus actions.

Current policy publication records an immutable source observation, policy provenance/outbox and each protected use decision. Corpus use rechecks the current policy inside its writer, denies without canonical publication, and durably audits the evaluated denial. Policy changes mark exact corpus paths and generic transitive outputs for review; bounded continuation and per-output inspection fail closed when propagation is pending or unknown. Populated v17 outputs receive immutable legacy review markers without invented rights grants.

Fresh exact-commit rights (48), corpus (42), affected foundation-control (64) and focused TypeScript (9) tests pass. Rights migration tests include literal populated v17 import/connector histories, verified backup/reopen/restore, interruption/retry and direct-SQL forgery denials. The Windows runtime case exercises an authenticated principal, accepted Intent, actual DPAPI/SQLCipher, restart, policy revocation, denied corpus write, immutable audit and exact output recheck.

Corpus integration tests cover explicit connector policy, replay, forged assertion, wrong Work, rollback and service denial propagation. The generated schema/client and Core API parity checks pass; no reported source term, static-only check or mock is used as sole proof of the protected boundary.

Versioned Python/JSON/TypeScript rights contracts and bounded authenticated Core routes expose inspectable decisions and review scope. Additive v18 canonical storage/profile and migration retain the literal frozen v17 recovery snapshot at SHA256 4388b3b35df43204ead46972d4fff67670084a5f82d40b046a09bc6a6fdb4d2a. Architecture/storage and contract documentation describe metadata-only protected publication, future copy provenance requirements and T03 output-guard consumption.

Append-only policy, use-decision, legacy-output and recheck records carry exact source/actor/trace/revision hashes without research content. Architecture, build-schema inventory, repository structure and 447-file Python quality checks pass; the verification contract includes service:rights in later full service/security qualification while this task uses selected affected checks.
